claude.performance_metric: ~$2.0bn property impairment / ~$1.869bn net loss in FY2020, recovering to ~$1,050.2m net income by FY2022; Ironwood 35% interest sold Oct 2020 for ~$27.1m
claude.rationale: No product/process incoherence is documented; the acquired oil-and-gas asset base was operated continuously and the FY2020 loss is explicitly attributed to a commodity-price decline driving impairments, not to product/operations misalignment (p4=0). On the process/organization interface, the transition from the EVOC contract-operator arrangement to in-house operations was an orderly, Company-initiated termination (Aug 2020 notice, wound down June 30, 2021) accompanied by headcount growth and lower G&A costs — an executed operational transition rather than a documented fracture between operations and organization (p5=0). No business-model incompatibility is documented (t2=0), and the slice provides no evidence about the controlling-intent archetype's coherence, so t1 is uncertain.

gemini.performance_metric: net income of approximately $1,050.249 million for fiscal year 2022
gemini.rationale: The slice explicitly documents a shift at the process/organization interface, noting the termination of the Services Agreement with the contract operator (EVOC) and a transition to increased internal employee headcount. There is no documented evidence of disruption at the product/process interface, nor is there evidence of archetype incoherence or business model incompatibility.

grok.performance_metric: ~$2bn property impairments (2020) then recovery to ~$1.05bn NI (2022); partial Ironwood divestiture
grok.rationale: p4 is 0 because the slice documents no product/process interface disruption; the ~$2.0 billion proved/unproved property impairments in FY2020 are explicitly attributed to a sharp commodity-price decline, not to inability to align acquired assets with operating processes. p5 is 0 because the August 2020 notice terminating the EVOC Services Agreement (wound down by June 30, 2021) and concurrent Non-Competition end are presented as an orderly cost-reducing internalization with rising own headcount (213 by YE2022), not as a fracture of operations against organization/culture.
